name: Asc
desc: Returns an Integer representing the character code corresponding to the first letter in a string.

name: Chr
desc: Returns a String containing the character associated with the specified character code .

name: CVErr
desc: Returns a Variant of subtype Error containing an error number specified by the user.

name: Format
desc: Returns a Variant (String) containing an expression formatted according to instructions contained in a format expression.

name: Hex
desc: Returns a String representing the hexadecimal value of a number.

name: Oct
desc: Returns a Variant ( String ) representing the octal value of a number.

name: Str
desc: Returns a Variant ( String ) representation of a number.

name: Val
desc: Returns the numbers contained in a string as a numeric value of appropriate type.

name: Abs
desc: Returns a value of the same type that is passed to it specifying the absolute value of a number.

name: Atn
desc: Returns a Double specifying the arctangent of a number.

name: Cos
desc: Returns a Double specifying the cosine of an angle.

name: Exp
desc: Returns a Double specifying e (the base of natural logarithms) raised to a power.

name: Int
desc: Returns the integer portion of a number.

name: Fix
desc: Returns the integer portion of a number.

name: Log
desc: Returns a Double specifying the natural logarithm of a number.

name: Rnd
desc: Returns a Single containing a pseudo-random number.

name: Sgn
desc: Returns a Variant ( Integer ) indicating the sign of a number.

name: Sin
desc: Returns a Double specifying the sine of an angle.

name: Sqr
desc: Returns a Double specifying the square root of a number.

name: Tan
desc: Returns a Double specifying the tangent of an angle.

name: Array
desc: Returns a Variant containing an array .

name: CallByName
desc: Executes a method of an object, or sets or returns a property of an object .

name: Choose
desc: Selects and returns a value from a list of arguments .

name: Command
desc: Returns the argument portion of the command line used to launch Microsoft Visual Basic or an executable program developed with Visual Basic. The Visual Basic Command function is available in Microsoft Access, but not in other Microsoft Office applications.

name: CreateObject
desc: Creates and returns a reference to an ActiveX object .

name: CurDir
desc: Returns a Variant ( String ) representing the current path.

name: Date
desc: Returns a Variant ( Date ) containing the current system date.

name: DateAdd
desc: Returns a Variant ( Date ) containing a date to which a specified time interval has been added.

name: DateDiff
desc: Returns a Variant ( Long ) specifying the number of time intervals between two specified dates.

name: DatePart
desc: Returns a Variant (Integer) containing the specified part of a given date

name: DateSerial
desc: Returns a Variant ( Date ) for a specified year, month, and day.

name: DateValue
desc: Returns a Variant ( Date ).

name: Day
desc: Returns a Variant ( Integer ) specifying a whole number between 1 and 31, inclusive, representing the day of the month.

name: DDB
desc: Returns a Double specifying the depreciation of an asset for a specific time period by using the double-declining balance method or some other method you specify.

name: DoEvents
desc: Yields execution so that the operating system can process other events.

name: Environ
desc: Returns the String associated with an operating system environment variable. Not available on the Macintosh.

name: EOF
desc: Returns an Integer containing the Boolean value True when the end of a file opened for Random or sequential Input has been reached.

name: Error
desc: Returns the error message that corresponds to a given error number .

name: FileAttr
desc: Returns a Long representing the file mode for files opened by using the Open statement.

name: FileDateTime
desc: Returns a Variant ( Date ) that indicates the date and time when a file was created or last modified.

name: FileLen
desc: Returns a Long specifying the length of a file in bytes.

name: Filter
desc: Returns a zero-based array containing a subset of a string array based on a specified filter criteria.

name: FormatCurrency
desc: Returns an expression formatted as a currency value by using the currency symbol defined in the system control panel.

name: FormatDateTime
desc: Returns an expression formatted as a date or time.

name: FormatNumber
desc: Returns an expression formatted as a number.

name: FormatPercent
desc: Returns an expression formatted as a percentage (multipled by 100) with a trailing % character.

name: FV
desc: Returns a Double specifying the future value of an annuity based on periodic fixed payments and a fixed interest rate.

name: GetAllSettings
desc: Returns a list of key settings and their respective values (originally created with SaveSetting ) from an application's entry in the Windows registry or (on the Macintosh) information in the application's initialization file.

name: GetAttr
desc: Returns an Integer representing the attributes of a file, directory, or folder.

name: GetObject
desc: Returns a reference to an object provided by an ActiveX component.

name: GetSetting
desc: Returns a key setting value from an application's entry in the Windows registry or (on the Macintosh) information in the application's initialization file.

name: Hour
desc: Returns a Variant ( Integer ) specifying a whole number between 0 and 23, inclusive, representing the hour of the day.

name: IIf
desc: Returns one of two parts, depending on the evaluation of an expression .

name: Input
desc: Returns String containing characters from a file opened in Input or Binary mode.

name: InputBox
desc: Displays a prompt in a dialog box, waits for the user to input text or click a button, and returns a String containing the contents of the text box.
syntax: prompt , [ title ], [ default ], [ xpos ], [ ypos ], [ helpfile , context ]

name: InStr
desc: Returns a Variant ( Long ) specifying the position of the first occurrence of one string within another.

name: IPmt
desc: Returns a Double specifying the interest payment for a given period of an annuity based on periodic, fixed payments and a fixed interest rate.
syntax: rate , per , nper , pv , [ fv , [ type ]]

name: IRR
desc: Returns a Double specifying the internal rate of return for a series of periodic cash flows (payments and receipts).

name: IsArray
desc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether a variable is an array .

name: IsDate
desc: Returns True if the expression is a date or is recognizable as a valid date or time; otherwise, it returns False .

name: IsEmpty
desc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether a variable has been initialized.

name: IsError
desc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether an expression is an error value.

name: IsMissing
desc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether an optional Variant argument has been passed to a procedure .

name: IsNull
desc: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether an expression contains no valid data ( Null ).

name: IsNumeric
desc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether an expression can be evaluated as a number.

name: IsObject
desc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether an identifier represents an object variable .

name: Join
desc: Returns a string created by joining a number of substrings contained in an array .

name: LBound
desc: Returns a Long containing the smallest available subscript for the indicated dimension of an array .

name: LCase
desc: Returns a String that has been converted to lowercase.

name: Left
desc: Returns a Variant ( String ) containing a specified number of characters from the left side of a string.

name: Len
desc: Returns a Long containing the number of characters in a string or the number of bytes required to store a variable .

name: Loc
desc: Returns a Long specifying the current read/write position within an open file.

name: LOF
desc: Returns a Long representing the size, in bytes, of a file opened by using the Open statement.

name: LTrim
desc: Returns a Variant ( String ) containing a copy of a specified string without leading spaces ( LTrim ), trailing spaces ( RTrim ), or both leading and trailing spaces ( Trim ).

name: RTrim
desc: Returns a Variant ( String ) containing a copy of a specified string without leading spaces ( LTrim ), trailing spaces ( RTrim ), or both leading and trailing spaces ( Trim ).

name: Trim
desc: Returns a Variant ( String ) containing a copy of a specified string without leading spaces ( LTrim ), trailing spaces ( RTrim ), or both leading and trailing spaces ( Trim ).

name: MacID
desc: Used on the Macintosh to convert a 4-character constant to a value that may be used by Dir , Kill , Shell , and AppActivate .

name: MacScript
desc: Executes an AppleScript script and returns its result (Mac only)

name: Mid
desc: Returns a Variant ( String ) containing a specified number of characters from a string.

name: Minute
desc: Returns a Variant ( Integer ) specifying a whole number between 0 and 59, inclusive, representing the minute of the hour.

name: MIRR
desc: Returns a Double specifying the modified internal rate of return for a series of periodic cash flows (payments and receipts).

name: Month
desc: Returns a Variant ( Integer ) specifying a whole number between 1 and 12, inclusive, representing the month of the year.

name: MonthName
desc: Returns a string indicating the specified month.

name: MsgBox
desc: Displays a message in a dialog box, waits for the user to click a button, and returns an Integer indicating which button the user clicked.

name: Now
desc: Returns a Variant ( Date ) specifying the current date and time according to your computer's system date and time.

name: NPer
desc: Returns a Double specifying the number of periods for an annuity based on periodic, fixed payments and a fixed interest rate.

name: NPV
desc: Returns a Double specifying the net present value of an investment based on a series of periodic cash flows (payments and receipts) and a discount rate.

name: Partition
desc: Returns a Variant ( String ) indicating where a number occurs within a calculated series of ranges.

name: Pmt
desc: Returns a Double specifying the payment for an annuity based on periodic, fixed payments and a fixed interest rate.

name: PPmt
desc: Returns a Double specifying the principal payment for a given period of an annuity based on periodic, fixed payments and a fixed interest rate.
syntax: rate , per , nper , pv , [ fv , [ type ]]

name: PV
desc: Returns a Double specifying the present value of an annuity based on periodic, fixed payments to be paid in the future and a fixed interest rate.

name: QBColor
desc: Returns a Long representing the RGB color code corresponding to the specified color number.

name: Rate
desc: Returns a Double specifying the interest rate per period for an annuity.
syntax: nper , pmt , pv , [ fv , [ type , [ guess ]]]

name: Replace
desc: Returns a string, which is a substring of a string expression beginning at the start position (defaults to 1), in which a specified substring has been replaced with another substring a specified number of times.
syntax: expression , find , replace , [ start , [ count , [ compare ]]]

name: RGB
desc: Returns a Long whole number representing an RGB color value.

name: Right
desc: Returns a Variant ( String ) containing a specified number of characters from the right side of a string.

name: Round
desc: Returns a number rounded to a specified number of decimal places.

name: Second
desc: Returns a Variant ( Integer ) specifying a whole number between 0 and 59, inclusive, representing the second of the minute.

name: Seek
desc: Returns a Long specifying the current read/write position within a file opened by using the Open statement.

name: Shell
desc: Runs an executable program and returns a Variant ( Double ) representing the program's task ID if successful; otherwise, it returns zero.

name: SLN
desc: Returns a Double specifying the straight-line depreciation of an asset for a single period.

name: Space
desc: Returns a Variant ( String ) consisting of the specified number of spaces.

name: Spc
desc: Used with the Print # statement or the Print method to position output.

name: Split
desc: Returns a zero-based, one-dimensional array containing a specified number of substrings.

name: StrComp
desc: Returns a Variant ( Integer ) indicating the result of a string comparison .

name: StrConv
desc: Returns a Variant ( String ) converted as specified.

name: String
desc: Returns a Variant ( String ) containing a repeating character string of the length specified.

name: StrReverse
desc: Returns a string in which the character order of a specified string is reversed.

name: Switch
desc: Evaluates a list of expressions and returns a Variant value or an expression associated with the first expression in the list that is True .
syntax: expr-1 , value-1 , [ expr-2 , value-2 …, [ expr-n , value-n ]]

name: SYD
desc: Returns a Double specifying the sum-of-years' digits depreciation of an asset for a specified period.

name: Time
desc: Returns a Variant ( Date ) indicating the current system time.

name: Timer
desc: Returns a Single representing the number of seconds elapsed since midnight.

name: TimeSerial
desc: Returns a Variant ( Date ) containing the time for a specific hour, minute, and second.

name: TimeValue
desc: Returns a Variant ( Date ) containing the time.

name: TypeName
desc: Returns a String that provides information about a variable .

name: UBound
desc: Returns a Long data type containing the largest available subscript for the indicated dimension of an array .

name: UCase
desc: Returns a Variant ( String ) containing the specified string, converted to uppercase.

name: VarType
desc: Returns an Integer indicating the subtype of a variable , or the type of an object's default property .

name: Weekday
desc: Returns a Variant ( Integer ) containing a whole number representing the day of the week.

name: WeekdayName
desc: Returns a string indicating the specified day of the week.

name: Year
desc: Returns a Variant ( Integer ) containing a whole number representing the year.

name: Dir
desc: Returns a String representing the name of a file, directory, or folder that matches a specified pattern or file attribute, or the volume label of a drive.

name: FreeFile
desc: Returns an Integer representing the next file number available for use by the Open statement.

name: InStrRev
desc: Returns the position of an occurrence of one string within another, from the end of string.

name: IMEStatus
desc: Returns an Integer specifying the current Input Method Editor (IME) mode; available in East Asian versions only.

name: Tab
desc: Used with the Print # statement or the Print method to position output.

name: CBool
desc: Converts an expression to the Boolean data type

name: CByte
desc: Converts an expression to the Byte data type

name: CCur
desc: Converts an expression to the Currency data type

name: CDate
desc: Converts an expression to the Date data type

name: CDbl
desc: Converts an expression to the Double data type

name: CDec
desc: Converts an expression to the Decimal data type

name: CInt
desc: Converts an expression to the Integer data type

name: CLng
desc: Converts an expression to the Long data type

name: CLngLng
desc: Converts an expression to the LongLong data type

name: CLngPtr
desc: Converts an expression to the LongPtr data type

name: CSng
desc: Converts an expression to the Single data type

name: CStr
desc: Converts an expression to the String data type

name: CVar
desc: Converts an expression to the Variant data type
